package.description: Before sharing sensitive and/or confidential files from your NAS, use File Station to encrypt them into .qenc files.

en-US.description: Before sharing sensitive and/or confidential files from your NAS, use File Station to encrypt them into .qenc files.
en-US.longDescription:
Before sharing sensitive and/or confidential files from your NAS, use File Station to encrypt them into .qenc files. Recipients can then decrypt these files using the QENC Decrypter. Only those with the password will be able to decrypt, view, and use the encrypted files.
Files that have been encrypted and compressed using Hybrid Backup Sync can also be decrypted and decompressed using the QENC Decrypter.
en-US.name: QENC Decrypter

zh-CN.description: 在分享 NAS 中的机密文件前，请先使用 File Station 将文件加密为 .qenc 格式。
zh-CN.longDescription:
当您需分享 NAS 中的机密文件时，可先通过 File Station 将文件进行加密，加强机密文件的安全保护等级。加密后的文件将转为无法随意存取的 .qenc 格式，收到文件的用户可在计算机上下载 QENC Decrypter 解密文件，只有输入正确密码才能查看、使用经过加密的 .qenc 文件，有效提升数据安全性。
通过 Hybrid Backup Sync 加密及压缩的文件，亦可使用 QENC Decrypter 解密及解压缩。
